bayts.text: The Best of the Everlasting (Allah) has answered me: in Him my whole being has become good; and He, through what He led to me, has raised up Poles (al-aqṭāb).
For the Face of the Everlasting (Allah), who erased for us any intent (to take back) what had been sold, I left it (the world) while it was a deep sea; and hope was not disappointed.
I have sold what does not turn towards me, and mine is my recompense; and He (Allah) who flung down the clamorous (foe) makes it everlasting for me.
Towards others than me the enemies head, with whatever they carry; and through me my God purifies minds at all times.
The hearts of those who do not love me are in fear; they do not meet what they longed for, nor (find) the Gate (of grace).
Every wish the noble have longed for yields to me; and God, through what He led to me, has raised up Poles (al-aqṭāb).
